commit.message:
docs(team): reported failures fixed the same turn; read before calling a cause unknown; S brief caps; terse updates; T6 in review

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore(AG-1,2,3,7): team v2 - one session per item, review depth and screenshots by size, sizing by risk

- CLAUDE.md: "How we work" principles; one fresh worktree session per item;
  Aiden-reported bugs triaged the same turn; sizing by risk and open decisions;
  S reviews on Sonnet; S runs affected e2e specs only; desktop-only viewports
  (1440x900 + 1366x650); one Playwright run per checkout.
- /bug: one Sonnet dev writes the repro test then the fix; review and UX check
  in parallel on Sonnet; delta review for cycle 2.
- /ship: session check; review and UX check in parallel; delta review.
- code-reviewer: depth by size, skip (CI) invariants, "Enforce mechanically" line.
- ux-reviewer: screenshot budget, Read only what's judged, arrive by direct URL.
- backlog: milestones instead of dates (Team v2, finish the demo, E1); B1 done;
  T5 folded into AG-6. demo-mvp spec: Oct 13 date dropped.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: qa-engineer writes tests on Sonnet at xhigh; Opus only thinks, verifies and oversees

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: Sonnet codes at xhigh, Opus tests and oversees; escalation goes through architect, never Opus coding

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: skills reference CLAUDE.md instead of restating it

- /ship and /bug point to CLAUDE.md for sizing, branch command,
  worktrees, escalation and "devs never edit tests".
- "both viewports" replaces spelled-out sizes.
- /debate rationale cut to one clause; /ux-pass reads Minors from
  REPORT.md now that ux-reviewer returns a summary.
- Frontmatter unchanged: these skills are user-invoked only, so their
  descriptions never load into context.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: agent files keep only role-specific rules, add return contracts

- Drop rules every subagent already has from root CLAUDE.md or reads in
  its folder CLAUDE.md (purity, card text, rule numbers, intents, timings,
  payload parsing, tokens, viewports, never commit, never edit qa tests).
- Every agent ends with a Return format and length cap; build output is
  capped at the last 10 lines of `npm run check`.
- ux-reviewer returns the REPORT.md path, Blockers/Majors and the Minor
  count instead of the whole report, and reads client/CLAUDE.md first.
- architect gets Edit so it appends its Design section instead of
  rewriting the spec.
- Shorter descriptions (they load into the main session every turn).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: agent rules that contradict the shipped code

- server-dev, architect: payloads use the hand-written parsers in
  shared/protocol.ts, not zod (server/CLAUDE.md already said so).
- T1 landed: qa-engineer and ux-reviewer use e2e/helpers.ts; /ship verify
  runs `npm run e2e` (the Definition of done already required it).
- Branches and code-reviewer diffs use origin/main. Local main lags: a
  review of DM-5 against local main covered 70 files instead of 38.
- qa-engineer's vitest scope includes server tests (server/app.test.ts).
- First Light example no longer points at current Game.tsx code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: disable Vercel plugin for this project

The user-level Vercel plugin adds ~37 skill descriptions and 3 agents
(~3.1k tokens) to every main-session turn. AFTERLIGHT deploys on Railway,
so none of it applies here. Committed (not settings.local.json) so new
worktree sessions inherit it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
chore: agent team, CLAUDE.md, backlog, check script
